findings.desc: doc-code-drift: docs/requirements/decisions/role-separation.md:1065-1088 tells owner sessions to materialize advisory reviewer output by calling finding_add/review_pass_set and says ordinary lattice-review-* reviewers directly call those evidence writers. The implemented authority contract rejects REVIEW evidence lacking either an exact managed receipt binding or a registered-broker native invocation attestation (packages/main/src/core/review-run.ts:1499-1509); native direct evidence without the broker attestation is explicitly advisory-only (packages/main/src/core/native-review-evidence.ts:165-170), and direct final evidence inside ManagedHostRun is forbidden (packages/main/src/handlers/finding.ts:511-517). Following the documented recovery path therefore creates inadmissible evidence or encourages controller impersonation. Update this section to state that advisory output remains non-authoritative, broker-attested native reviewers use the direct path, and cross-provider reviewers use the sealed ManagedHostRun proposal/import path.
